answer: Jade-trace payment fingerprinting. Every agent identity accrues a slow-moving ridge of tiny unique transaction timing and amount patterns, like sediment along a river. Post-hoc, cluster analysis groups identities whose fingerprint residuals correlate above threshold; clusters exceeding size N are quarantined and their accrued rewards clawed back. An attacker must sustain distinct, uncorrelated timing and amount behavior per identity for many epochs, raising marginal cost per sybil roughly to the cost of operating a genuinely independent agent.
